The one sign-in form. Its body morphs in place through the sign-in methods, the browser hand-off, the license choice and Done, inline, in a sheet or in the browser. No sheet or dialog stacks on it; `presentation` and `replace` take the same values in every kit.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    **Drop-in.** `login` / `sign-in`: the browser presentation only (SIGN-IN.md §4.15): it opens the browser and waits; Enter opens it again, `c` uses a code, Esc cancels; `--json` prints `pending` then the result.

    **Styled part.** `screens.sign_in(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `SignInModel` over `identity.begin_sign_in` and `wait_for_sign_in` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
